full_judgment:
Heard the submissions of learned advocate for the petitioner and perused the application filed through online on 2-6-2020 under section 10(1A) of the Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1958 (XL of 1958) and the annexures annexed thereto. 

 2. This is an application under section 10(1A) under section 10(1 A) of the Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1958 (XL of 1958) filed by the petitioner challenging the order dated 27-5-2020 passed by the learned Special Judge, Tangail in Virtual Court Case No. 19 of 2020 arising out of Special Case (Money Laundering) No.1 of 2019 arising out of Tangail Model PS Case No.21 dated 16-9-2018 corresponding to ACC GR No.403 of 2018 under section 4 of the Money Laundering Protirodh Ain, 2012, now pending in the Court of Special Judge, Tangail.
